subject: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal: evidence bundle + capacity uplift
messages:
From: Asha Mehta <asha@fintechone.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation and renewal questions

Hi Kimberly / Karthik,

FintechOne's renewal is coming up (contract ends 2026-10-31). Procurement looped me in to start the SOC 2 re-attestation conversation. A few asks from our security team so we can move the renewal to signature: 

- Confirm SOC 2 status and whether there are any control changes since last year.
- Provide an evidence bundle (playbook/checklist) and a sample of audit logs showing retention / export format.
- We have a projected throughput increase (approx +60% token volume) and want an estimate for capacity uplift and pricing for reserved capacity for 12 months.

Can you confirm what you need from our side and an estimated timeline? Ideally we'd have the evidence review in the next 10 business days to hit our internal audit window.

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Mehta
Head of Security Ops, FintechOne
asha@fintechone.com
+1 415-555-0199

--
Attachment: renewal_request.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha@fintechone.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation and renewal questions

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. We're ready to support the review and have sketched a pragmatic path to keep your renewal on schedule. High level: 

1) SOC 2 posture: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II 2025 and has no control changes that affect data handling since then. We'll include a short executive summary and the attestation PDF in the bundle.

2) Evidence bundle + logs: I attached our SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.pdf that maps common evidence requests to locations (Console exports, Audit Logs, KMS proofs). For the logs sample, we've attached log-export-sample.csv (sanitized). If your team wants a different retention slice or additional fields, tell us which date range and we can generate it.

3) Capacity uplift / pricing: Karthik will provide the cost delta and options (burst vs dedicated). Preliminary note — for a ~60% sustained increase we recommend a Dedicated pool with a 12-month commit; we'll include a pricing addendum draft.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (09/01): Share checklist + log sample (attached).
- 09/03: Your security team reviews checklist and confirms any gaps.
- 09/06: We consolidate any supplemental evidence and share the full Drive bundle + a one-page attestation.
- 09/08: Pricing amendment and contract redline delivered for procurement.

If that works, I'll loop in Marissa from CS to coordinate the evidence handoff and DocuSign amendment.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0123

--
Attachments: SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.pdf, log-export-sample.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Asha Mehta <asha@fintechone.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation and renewal questions

Thanks — quick pricing note to help you plan: 

- Option A (Dedicated 12m commit): suitable for sustained +60% throughput. Estimated uplift $18,000/month, with a one-time migration/data onboarding fee of $1,200. This preserves lower per-token pricing and gives reserved capacity guarantees.
- Option B (Burst + Hosted mix): lower commit, higher per-token cost during sustained peaks. Estimated $9,000/month plus usage overage tiers.

I've uploaded a first-pass amendment draft to the shared Drive (link below) and attached renewal-amendment-draft.docx to this thread for procurement's convenience. If procurement prefers, we can route the amendment through DocuSign after your internal approval.

If you want a firm quote, tell me the forecasted monthly request volume (vs current) and preferred contract term; I'll convert to an exact price and update the HubSpot deal (FT1-2026-REN-42).

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/34567/FT1-2026-REN-42 ; https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefGHIjk-LINK-example

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha@fintechone.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation and renewal questions

Asha — looping in next steps from the CS side. Thanks for getting this started. To keep the audit window we suggest the following concrete items from FintechOne by EOD 09/03: 

- Approver list for the attestation (names/emails of who can sign the amendment).
- Any specific CSV fields/filters you need in the log sample (we can run another export).
- Confirmed monthly forecast (current baseline + projected %).

Action items from our side (we'll deliver by 09/08):
- Full evidence Drive folder with attestation PDF, SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.pdf, sanitized log export, and mapping notes.
- Contract amendment draft for procurement (attached in Karthik's note).
- A short runbook for log transport options (S3 transfer vs secure API) and expected timelines for transfer.

If you confirm approvers and forecast today we'll send the Drive bundle and route the amendment for signature next week. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if your team prefers to walk through the evidence mapping.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
